payload.body:
Affected: Manila (74.0 km/h), Pasay City (50.3 km/h)

Risk: flying debris, structural damage, dangerous travel conditions.
Action: Stay indoors, secure loose items, avoid motorcycles.
Prepare: Signal No. 2 level; PAGASA usually warns about 24 hours before.
Hotlines: Emergency 911 | NDRRMC (02) 8911-1406 | PAGASA (02) 8284-0800 | Manila DRRMO 0932 662 2322
